system._security_note: Lexical rule retained and unchanged; a semantic detector (local MiniLM, no network, no vendor) is unioned with it so the composite can only ADD a detection. Measured on 24 independent descriptions of 7 security categories: lexical 2/24, composite 24/24, with 0/10 false positives on benign traffic. Routing escalates on security across every intent and confidence value, proven exhaustively.

evaluation._agent_note: Evaluated at commit 6772707 on the frozen 200-example golden set (reports/golden_eval/). Later source changes are hardening only; a cache-only replay of the current code reproduces all 800 prediction rows with 0 differences (reports/golden_eval/evaluation_boundary.md).
evaluation._golden_note: 200 human-adjudicated labels with model-assisted pre-annotation (40 blind, 160 assisted: 159 accepted, 1 corrected; 1 retraction kept). Frozen by scripts/freeze_golden.py into data/golden/GOLDEN_LOCK.json (content_sha256 6d78823a...) AFTER the evaluation ran; the labels in the evaluated predictions equal the locked labels (0 mismatches).
evaluation._retraction_note: One pass-1 annotation (101236__101237) was entered before the annotation guide had been read and was withdrawn by the annotator. The original record is preserved in annotations.jsonl for audit; its label is excluded everywhere and the example returns to the queue. Retracted labels can never reach gold: load_gold and the freeze both read effective annotations.
evaluation._assisted_note: 160 candidates carry a PROVISIONAL model suggestion (MODEL_GENERATED, separate file, separate type); 40 are blind per SPEC 9.2 so anchoring bias stays measurable. A suggestion is never gold: it becomes a label only when a human accepts or corrects it, and the review_action plus the suggestion shown are recorded on every label. These will NOT be 200 independently-classified-from-scratch labels and must never be described as such.
evaluation._evaluation_note: Evaluated on all 200 golden examples (reports/golden_eval/). DISCLOSURE: 159/160 assisted labels are identical to the Llama pre-annotation, accepted at a median 0.4s, so all-200 metrics measure agreement with human-accepted model pre-annotation; the 40 blind labels are reported separately. Judge is groq qwen/qwen3.8-27b after the Claude judge failed on OpenRouter HTTP 402 (zero credits). Judge-human agreement UNMEASURED: no human reply-quality ratings exist.

honest_summary: An end-to-end support resolution agent for AppleSupport was evaluated on a frozen 200-example golden set that is human-adjudicated with model-assisted pre-annotation (40 blind, 160 assisted; 159 of 160 assisted labels equal the Llama suggestion). Against always-escalate and a TF-IDF/rules baseline, the LLM agent auto-handles 44% with a false auto-handle rate of 38.7% [27.9-50.0]; always-escalate is cheaper at error-cost ratios of 8 and above. Judge (qwen/qwen3.8-27b) relevance 4.20, helpfulness 3.52; judge-human agreement is UNMEASURED. No threshold was tuned on gold. Release audit: 15/15 mutation controls caught, 15/15 failure paths fail closed, 0 of 800 decisions changed by hardening. Final report not yet written.

brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.what_happened: Two defects were fixed in reply_classify: stem-only verb patterns missed inflected forms ('restarting'), and the English gate rejected terse navigation instructions, systematically discarding the most actionable replies.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.impact: Re-running the brand analysis raises actionable_resolution_rate by ~0.092 on average and usable_grounding_evidence_pairs by ~1487 per brand. Brands passing the pre-registered filters rise from 5 to 27. AmazonHelp and AppleSupport then tie at rubric score 0.7246 (exact to 6dp); the current winner is decided by sort order.
